script_text: Stop, Taurus: Venus is turning your relationship instincts up, not down. With Taurus leading the whole-sign chart, Venus at 19° Libra is sextile 19° Taurus, your planetary ruler, energizing the 6th House of work and money routines. The Sun at 2° Libra opposes 2° Taurus, lighting the 7th House of partnerships. Your fixed-earth element needs steady affection, not fireworks. If single, approach someone grounded in your daily routine today and show up clearly; if partnered, share one specific request before assuming your partner can read your mind. That Venus–Taurus sextile supports a 6th-House raise discussion, improved pay, or a useful referral, especially when you name your contribution calmly and ask for a clear number. Avoid overpromising on a deadline today; a small favor can become a much larger workload when boundaries blur. Subscribe so you don’t miss tomorrow’s new reading.
